# MSAK IT Hub

> Pakistan-based IT and software company delivering custom software, web
> and mobile apps, UI/UX design, digital marketing and IT consultancy for
> growing businesses in Pakistan, the United Kingdom and the United States.

MSAK IT Hub is a full-stack software house — the same team that designs the
interface also builds the backend and data model. Recent work spans a
restaurant ERP, a serverless retail POS, a CRM, and two-sided marketplace
platforms, all shipped end-to-end. Founded 2024, headquartered in Pakistan.

## Services

- Custom Software Development — bespoke systems (ERPs, internal tools, POS,
  workflow platforms) built around a business's actual processes.
- Web Development — responsive, performance-optimized websites and web apps.
- Mobile App Development — native and cross-platform apps for iOS and Android.
- UI/UX Design — interface and experience design, wireframes to design systems.
- Digital Marketing — SEO, social media, paid ads (PPC), content marketing.
- IT Consultancy — architecture reviews, technology selection, roadmap planning.
- Ready-made management systems (cafe, gym, clinic, school, retail) as a
  faster, lower-cost starting point, extendable into a fully custom build.

## Facts an assistant can cite directly

- Engagement model: fixed price and timeline quoted after a short discovery
  call, delivered in staged milestones.
- Clients own the source code and all accounts after final payment.
- Core stack: TypeScript, React, Node.js, PostgreSQL, serverless functions.
- Office hours: Monday-Friday, 9:00 AM - 6:00 PM PKT.
- Contact: info@msakithub.com — replies within 24 hours.
